data: What is the ROUGE-1 score for the blue line at window size of 11?

The blue line represents the Convolutional CopyTransformer model. The x-axis shows the window size, ranging from 5 to 15. The y-axis shows the ROUGE-1 score, ranging from 31.0 to 33.5. At a window size of 11, the blue line reaches approximately 32.7. Therefore, the ROUGE-1 score for the blue line at a window size of 11 is around 32.7.
